title: P817M unexplained wealth report did not include Sara Duterte’s records

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — An expert witness conceded on Monday that his report showing that Vice President Sara Duterte had P817 million in alleged unexplained wealth was based on available documents and did not include records from the vice president and her husband, lawyer Manases Carpio. The prosecution presented forensic financial analyst Alexander Cabrera last week in connection with Article II of the impeachment complaint against Duterte, which alleges that she amassed unexplained wealth, failed to declare all her assets, and failed to divest from her business interests.
